PURPOSE: Harvest Temporal's durable-execution seam for the PING MissionScheduler: (1) deterministic code-replay verification (re-run mission logic against canonical event history, compare regenerated commands to recorded events, divergence = typed failure), (2) worker-proposes / authority-materializes command-event boundary, (3) declarative authority-enforced Retry Policy (5 fields + interval formula), (4) timeout-based crash detection with heartbeat checkpoints, (5) revocation triple (cooperative cancel / immediate terminate / reset-to-history-point). Explicitly REJECTS the Temporal server, SDKs, sticky execution, workflow-task plumbing, and the 60-type event taxonomy (piging2 needs ~8 types).
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: Deterministic code-replay verification: re-run mission logic against the canonical event history, compare the commands it generates to the recorded events, and treat ANY divergence as a typed failure (never as state). PING's replay currently reads events to reconstruct a view; Temporal proves replay must run the mission's own logic against the history so the history becomes a falsifier. Pure function of (mission logic, history); zero dependencies; serves proofs 11/13/14 directly.
